findings.current: I tightened my grip and tore the webbing apart.
findings.defect: The Korean specifies that hundreds of layers of webbing tore helplessly under the narrator’s tremendous grip. That image and the scale of the webbing are omitted.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes hundreds of layers tearing under the narrator’s immense grip; the accepted baseline also preserves this detail.
findings.replacement: The hundreds of layers of tangled web tore helplessly under my terrifying grip.

findings.current: The Beast Miao King checked the unknown man’s faint pulse
findings.defect: The source says the man’s pulse was slow, not faint.
findings.rationale: 완맥 means a slow pulse; the accepted baseline renders it that way.
findings.replacement: The Beast Miao King checked the unknown man’s slow pulse

findings.current: Now I understood why the sight of this place had made my hair stand on end.
findings.defect: The source locates the reaction at the moment the narrator first set foot here. The translation instead attributes it to seeing the place.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly marks the moment of arrival and the narrator’s involuntary reaction.
findings.replacement: Now I understood why my hair had stood on end the moment I first set foot here.

findings.current: I’d bet they had a hand in it.
findings.defect: This suggests direct involvement more strongly than the source, which says they likely exerted at least some influence while leaving direct involvement uncertain.
findings.rationale: The narrator distinguishes uncertainty about direct involvement from confidence that Dark Heaven at least influenced events.
findings.replacement: They must have exerted at least some influence.

findings.current: Every time his straightened palm moved
findings.defect: The source describes a straightened knife-hand, not a palm.
findings.rationale: 수도 refers to a hand held like a blade; “palm” identifies a different part of the hand.
findings.replacement: Every time his straightened knife-hand moved

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but it omits a web-tearing detail and shifts several physical or temporal details.
